messages:
Alex (support): High-sev escalation: multiple hosted customers in us-west-2 seeing 5xx / timeouts to /v1/generate starting ~08:12 PST. Spike of 400+ 504/502s in 10m. Escalating now.
Tim (oncall): Acknowledged — looking. Any recent deploys or config changes?
Alex (support): No deploys at 08:00. KEDA metrics show huge queue-length spikes for tenant pools. Sample gateway log: 
Alex (support): ```
2026-02-18T08:12:34Z gateway: upstream error: dial tcp 10.1.5.23:8080: i/o timeout
2026-02-18T08:12:35Z autoscaler: scale request for pool inference-usw-1, target replicas 20 -> 60
2026-02-18T08:12:36Z kube-proxy: conntrack overflow, dropping new conns
```
Priya (eng-sre): I see the scaledobject for inference-usw has minReplica=0 and we lost the prewarm annotation on a recent Helm update. KEDA spun pods but readiness was flapping. `kubectl get scaledobject -n inference inference-pool-usw -o yaml` shows `annotations: {}` where we expect `keda.sh/prewarm: "true"`.
Carla (eng-runtime): Runtime note: cold model init for the LLM variant hits ~18s for load+kv-cache population. Our readinessProbe is currently light (initialDelaySeconds: 5, periodSeconds: 5) so pods marked Ready before warm cache. First requests then backlog and time out.
Tim (oncall): So the symptom is KEDA/HPA created pods, but they weren't fully serving -> connection backlog at gateway -> 504s.
Priya (eng-sre): Exactly. Also seeing kube-proxy conntrack churn. The net result: upstream endpoints unstable while gateway keeps routing.
Alex (support): Customer impact: 3 paying customers reported 504s and one customer saw repeated retries causing a billing mismatch. They've asked for RCA and ETA.
Dave (customer-success): Notified affected accounts, they want a timeline and mitigation now.
Carla (eng-runtime): Short-term mitigations: (A) annotate scaledobject with prewarm to keep low steady capacity; (B) increase readinessProbe.initialDelaySeconds to 60 for heavy-model pools; (C) reduce max surge in the deployment to avoid thundering warmups.
Tim (oncall): I'm going to apply mitigations in us-west-2 now: bump minReplicas=5 and patch readiness to 60s for inference-usw. Will also re-annotate scaledobject to prewarm=true.
Tim (oncall): ```
kubectl patch deployment inference-pool-usw -n inference --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"inference","readinessProbe":{"initialDelaySeconds":60}}]}}}}'
kubectl annotate scaledobject inference-pool-usw keda.sh/prewarm=true -n inference
kubectl scale deployment inference-pool-usw --replicas=5 -n inference
```
Priya (eng-sre): Also changing KEDA metric smoothing window. Current trigger is too sensitive for short-lived bursts. I'll increase stabilization (rolling avg) from 10s->60s and lower scale-up aggressiveness.
Carla (eng-runtime): Longer-term we should fail fast on cold-start requests (return 503 immediately) instead of hanging, and add a lightweight warmup probe for kv-cache readiness separate from Kubernetes readiness.
Emily (product): Please confirm no customer-facing config changes required. We'll prepare a short comms update.
Tim (oncall): Mitigations applied to inference-usw Canary. Observed connection backlog drop and gateway timeouts falling. Rolling to full region after 5m validation.
Alex (support): Repro steps captured: start from minReplica=0, ensure cache empty, hammer endpoint concurrently — we see scale-up, many pods report Ready but still return timeouts until cache warms.
Priya (eng-sre): Repro command (simple): 
Priya (eng-sre): ```bash
# repro: 300 concurrent requests to cold pool
ab -n 300 -c 100 -T 'application/json' -p payload.json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Carla (eng-runtime): Logs from a repro run: 
Carla (eng-runtime): ```
[08:14:01] inference-pod-7fdc: readinessProbe success, but kv-cache: miss, model init: ongoing (14s)
[08:14:02] gateway: upstream dial tcp 10.1.5.47:8080: i/o timeout
[08:14:05] runtime: serving first token (after kv-cache load)
```
Tim (oncall): After patch at 08:20 PST, 5xx rate dropped from ~18% to ~2% in the region. Gateway 504 alerts resolving.
Dave (customer-success): Customers updated that we mitigated and investigating root cause; they asked for PM follow-up.
Carla (eng-runtime): Action items: 
- Priya: KEDA/HPA tuning + enforce prewarm annotation via Helm and CI check
- Carla: Add kv-cache readiness probe + change cold-start behavior to quick 503s
- Tim: Roll mitigation across regions and add kube-proxy conntrack tuning doc
- Emily: Customer comms and incident notice
- Alex: Draft postmortem template
Priya (eng-sre): I'll attach the detailed keda/hpa manifests and exact patch diff in the postmortem. Repro script saved in /tmp/scaleup-repro.sh on my laptop (will upload).
Tim (oncall): Leaving thread open for postmortem notes. Current status: mitigated, rolling fix, customers notified. :thumbsup:
Alex (support): Thanks team — please add timestamps and links to logs in the PM doc. Closing in 24h pending postmortem.
